BiblicalUsage: Gaddiel son of Sodi is one of the twelve spies, named in Numbers 13:10 as the spy of the tribe of Zebulun. He went up with the others to search the land, and he came back with the report that turned the people's hearts. His name is kept in the list of the twelve.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spies' list is a warning as much as a record. Ten of the twelve brought back fear, and Gaddiel's name stands among them; I hold that the report we believe shapes the future we get.
